label: playCheck
js: (() => { const t0 = performance.now(); const r = game.playCheck(); return JSON.stringify({ ok: r.ok, total: r.total, failed: r.failed, ms: Math.round(performance.now() - t0) }); })()

label: playCheck mirror (must fail)
js: (() => { const r = game.playCheck('mirror'); return JSON.stringify({ ok: r.ok, failedCount: r.failed.length, first: r.failed.slice(0, 2) }); })()

label: playCheck stuckWall (must fail)
js: (() => { const r = game.playCheck('stuckWall'); return JSON.stringify({ ok: r.ok, failedCount: r.failed.length, first: r.failed.slice(0, 2) }); })()

label: headless check in the page
js: (() => { const r = game.check(['climbOnlyOpen', 'warningFirst']); return JSON.stringify({ ok: r.ok, failed: r.failed }); })()
